complete_declaration_types:
theorem sum_real_supported_progression_divisor_weights_le_lcm
    (S : Finset ℕ) {a b : ℝ} {D q : ℕ} {r : ℤ} (w : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (hmod : ∀ n ∈ S, Int.ModEq (q : ℤ) (n : ℤ) r)
    (hw : ∀ d ∈ Icc 1 D, 0 ≤ w d) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, ∑ d ∈ (Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => d ∣ n), w d) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D, w d * ((b - a) / (Nat.lcm d q : ℝ) + 1) := by
theorem sum_fouvryTau_real_progression_floor_lcm_payment
    (S : Finset ℕ) {K q : ℕ} {r : ℤ} (hK : 2 ≤ K) (hq : 0 < q)
    {a b Z : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hZ : 2 ≤ Z) (hbZ : b ≤ Z)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, a ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (hmod : ∀ n ∈ S, Int.ModEq (q : ℤ) (n : ℤ) r) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ)) ≤
      (K : ℝ) * ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊realDeletionRadius K Z⌋₊,
        (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) * ((b - a) / (Nat.lcm d q : ℝ) + 1) := by

theorem sum_real_supported_divisor_weights_swap (S : Finset ℕ) (D : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, ∑ d ∈ (Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => d ∣ n), w d) =
      ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D, w d * ((S.filter (fun n => d ∣ n)).card : ℝ) := by
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _hd
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

necessary_API_evidence.literal_source: def realDeletionRadius (K : ℕ) (Z : ℝ) : ℝ := Z ^ (((K - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (K : ℝ))

theorem floor_radius_strict_cutoff {K B : ℕ} (hK : 2 ≤ K) {Z : ℝ}
    (hZ : 1 ≤ Z) (hBZ : (B : ℝ) ≤ Z) :
    B ^ (K - 1) < (⌊realDeletionRadius K Z⌋₊ + 1) ^ K := by
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ realDeletionRadius K Z := le_trans zero_le_one (realDeletionRadius_bounds hK hZ).1
necessary_API_evidence.purpose: Strict successor-power bound at true floor

necessary_API_evidence.literal_source:
theorem truncated_divisor_carrier_eq {n D : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    n.divisors.filter (fun d => d ≤ D) = (Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => d ∣ n) := by
  ext d
  constructor
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨hdn, hdD⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hdn, hdD⟩,
        (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hdn).1⟩
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨hdI, hdn⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨hdn, hn.ne'⟩, (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hdI).2⟩
necessary_API_evidence.purpose: Actual divisor carrier equals positive bounded divisibility carrier when n>0

accepted_parent_record.scope: Only exact RealEndpoint source 5c386ee17594c075b81b15d56143284fd0f77364f87129d0a96632f17064f8ad. New wrapper inherits no acceptance.

static_checks.domains: S is any finite subset of Nat. Weighted helper assumes only a<=b, q>0, w(d)>=0 on Icc 1 D; no a>=0 restriction is introduced. Main finite payment assumes K>=2, 1<=a<=b<=Z, Z>=2. r is every Int, including negative/nonprimitive residues, independent of interval endpoints.
static_checks.positive_denominator: d in Icc 1 D gives 1<=d and hence d>0 by omega; hq:q>0 is passed explicitly. Thus Nat.lcm d q is positive. No q=0 generality is claimed.
static_checks.support_and_two_gates: The actual fiber is S.filter(fun n=>d|n). Its membership first projection supplies support and Int.ModEq q n r; second projection supplies d|n. Neither congruence nor divisibility is dropped or replaced by a shift-only residue.
static_checks.CRT_parent_body: For nonempty S, subtraction of the least natural element is injective and has support [0,b-a]; common Int.ModEq q yields q|(n-n0), d-divisibility yields d|(n-n0), and Nat.lcm_dvd combines them. Nat.cast_sub and Int.natCast_sub require and receive n0<=n. The actual multiple-count API is used with positive lcm. Empty case uses hab and nonnegative quotient. This review finds no mathematical or visible source/API mismatch in that future dependency, but has no compilation evidence for it.
static_checks.interchange: rw sum_real_supported_divisor_weights_swap gives exactly sum_d w(d)*card(S.filter(d|n)). Finset.sum_le_sum and mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left use precisely hw d hd. Generic weights need no sign assumption outside Icc 1 D.
static_checks.strict_cutoff: For n in S, ha and hS give n>0 and n>=1; hS upper endpoint trans hbZ gives n<=Z. hZ gives Z>=1. The actual floor_radius_strict_cutoff gives n^(K-1)<(D+1)^K for D=floor(realDeletionRadius K Z), with no ceiling substitution or endpoint rounding loss.
static_checks.tau_and_cast: fouvryTau is the native ArithmeticFunction Nat zeta power, not a surrogate. Native sharp truncation is applied with K>=2,n>=1,strict cutoff, then rewritten by truncated_divisor_carrier_eq hnpos. exact_mod_cast is the same cast step used in accepted RealEndpoint; all sums are finite and natural valued before casting.
static_checks.exact_K: K is arbitrary Nat >=2. Pointwise coefficient is exactly K. Finset.mul_sum pulls out the same K; the final inequality multiplies by Nat.cast_nonneg K. No K-dependent analytic estimate or giant exponent evaluation occurs.
static_checks.elaboration_surface: Namespace and opened scopes agree with actual parent. Generic helper explicit argument order matches S,w,hab,hq,hS,hmod,hw; implicit D is inferred from Icc carrier. Main local let D is definitionally the displayed floor, so the calc endpoint matches without an additional change tactic. Actual import resolution and elaboration remain untested.
static_checks.edge_cases: Empty S, singleton S, b=a, D=0 in helper, and arbitrary incompatible residue classes are permitted. Positive support in the tau theorem excludes n=0 as required by the divisor carrier lemma. Closed real support retains exactly b-a and the +1 endpoint allowance.
static_checks.forbidden_shortcuts: No sorry/admit/axiom, analytic supplier, coprimality assumption, compatible CRT representative premise, closed d_K(q)/q bound, or main theorem appears in these two bodies.
